caption: The drawing features a brass candlestick depicted prominently in the center of the composition, rendered in shades of yellow and gold to illustrate its metallic material. The candlestick has a wide, square base with chamfered corners and rises up through a series of smooth, bulbous, and tapered forms to a round holder at the top. To the upper left of the main image, there is a black-and-white line drawing showing a side profile of the candlestick, providing a technical contour of its shape. Below the profile, there is another line drawing that shows a top-down view of the base, highlighting its geometric proportions, and a small horizontal ruler indicating a scale from 0 to 3 units. The objects are set against a neutral, off-white background within a lightly defined rectangular border. At the lower left of the border, the printed text reads "PHILIP JOHNSON."
title: Candlestick
